children.description: MCP server exposing four cognitive harness tools (, , , ) OpenClaw agents call before generating. Each tool returns a structured prompt: a named failure pattern, an executable procedure, suppression vectors that block common shortcuts, and a falsification test for self-verification. Targets hallucinated APIs, sycophantic capitulation, false-confidence validation, and cross-turn drift on long agentic sessions. Two install paths: stdio via , or hosted HTTPS at . Requires (free tier at ejentum.com), MIT, listed on the Official MCP Registry as .

children.title: aquaman
children.description: - Credential isolation proxy — API keys never enter the agent process, injected via UDS from Keychain/1Password/Vault/keepassxc

children.title: APort Agent Guardrails
children.description: - Pre-action authorization for OpenClaw; plugin, allowlist + 40+ blocked patterns, local or API. Setup:

children.title: leashed
children.description: - Policy engine, audit log, and kill switch for AI agents. Allow/deny patterns, time limits, and emergency revocation.

children.title: OneCLI
children.description: - Open-source credential vault for AI agents. Rust HTTP gateway injects API keys transparently so agents never handle raw secrets. Per-agent scoped tokens, AES-256-GCM encryption at rest.

children.title: Armorer Guard
children.description: - Local Rust scanner and MCP proxy for AI-agent prompt injection, credential leakage, exfiltration, and risky tool-call arguments before execution.

children.title: OpenClaw VPS Security Preflight
children.description: - Free browser checklist and optional read-only Linux audit for gateway bind/auth, listeners, SSH, firewall, service hardening, updates, and time sync. No telemetry or host changes.

children.title: ClawLens
children.description: - Local-first observability and guardrails for OpenClaw agents — records every tool call before execution, scores risky behavior, keeps a tamper-evident hash-chain audit trail, and turns observed actions into block / require-approval / allow-notify guardrails delivered to Telegram.

children.title: iClaw
children.description: - Local-first AI workspace with sandboxed file execution — isolates files in containers, detects malware and credential theft before execution. npm: @iclawapp/iclaw

children.title: trentclaw
children.description: - Security assessment skill for OpenClaw — scans gateway config, installed skills, tool permissions, and MCP servers, finds chained attack paths, and returns prioritized findings with proposed fixes inside your OpenClaw session. ClawHub ·

children.title: Agent Browser Shield
children.description: - Safety layer between an AI agent and the web pages it visits — masks PII/secrets, blocks prompt injection in hidden text and HTML comments, and strips dark patterns and noise before pages reach the agent. Chromium extension, also on ClawHub.
